description: This file defines a REST API controller named VacancyRestController for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, specifically handling vacancy-related HTTP requests. It includes methods for retrieving vacancy details via GET requests, with other HTTP methods (POST, PUT, DELETE) currently unimplemented. It extends base API classes and uses traits/services for vacancy and normalization functionalities.

classes.name: VacancyRestController
classes.description: Controller handling REST API requests related to the Vacancy entity in the recruitment plugin, mainly handling GET requests to fetch vacancy details.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve details of a specific vacancy by ID.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended to handle POST requests for creating vacancies.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating the method is not implemented.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended for handling PUT requests to update a vacancy.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended for handling DELETE requests to delete a vacancy.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Initializes validation rules for GET requests, validating the 'id' parameter.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended for POST request validation rules.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended for PUT request validation rules.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended for DELETE request validation rules.
